_readme: Eleven v3 is the speech model for the voice-over and every spoken line of a video ad.
No brand, product, person or format word appears in this file.
Draft: every entry is status draft until the owner approves it.
label: ElevenLabs Eleven v3 (speech)

limits.max_prompt_chars_note: 5,000 comes from a third-party review only; ElevenLabs' own prompting page gives no number. Confirm before relying on it.
limits.output_formats: mp3 and pcm tiers (set by output_format)

house.reads: each line is its own read with that shot's delivery as an audio tag; never one long take for the whole piece

inputs.name: text
inputs.what: The words to speak plus audio tags and punctuation for delivery.
inputs.allowed: text; very short prompts give inconsistent output, over 250 characters is encouraged
inputs.we_send: one line per read with its delivery tag

inputs.name: voice_id
inputs.what: Which voice. The maker calls this the most important parameter.
inputs.allowed: a voice from the library or our designed voice

inputs.name: stability
inputs.what: How much the read follows direction. Creative and Natural respond to tags; Robust reduces responsiveness.

inputs.name: audio tags
inputs.what: Bracketed delivery: emotions, [whispers], [sighs], [laughs], sound effects like [applause].
inputs.allowed: short, clear tags matched to the voice

inputs.name: punctuation
inputs.what: Ellipses add pauses and weight, capitals add emphasis, standard marks set rhythm.

inputs.name: language_code
inputs.we_send: not sent: the text sets it

inputs.name: seed
inputs.we_send: not pinned: a bad read is remade

inputs.name: text-to-dialogue
inputs.we_send: not used: each line is its own read

structure.rule: Each line is its own read with that shot's delivery as a tag; never one long take for the whole piece.
Choose the voice first; a tag only works if the delivery already exists in the voice. A whisper tag fails on a loud voice.
Match tags to the voice's character: a serious voice does not respond well to playful tags.
Keep tags short, clear and about emotion, tone, pace or action; describe voice quality so it cannot be read as a sound cue.
Give it enough text; very short inputs are inconsistent.
structure.ours: lines over 250 characters are grouped or padded with context

structure.rule: Use ellipses for weight, capitals for emphasis and normal punctuation for rhythm instead of break tags.
For the most expressive read use Creative or Natural stability.
Write brand words and figures the way they are spoken; the text is the only lever.

avoid.text: SSML break tags: v3 ignores them.
Playful tags on a serious voice.
A Professional Voice Clone on v3 when clone quality matters: not fully optimised.
One long take for the whole piece.
A one-word or very short prompt.
Tags the voice reads aloud because they read like speech.
